evidence_snippets: KMS key name format: "projects/[PROJECT ID]/locations/[LOCATION]/keyRings/[KEYRING]/cryptoKeys/[KEY]" For example: "projects/my-project/locations/us-central1/keyRings/my-ring/cryptoKeys/my-key" To enable CMEK, set this field to a valid kmsKeyName for which the associated service account has the required roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter role assigned for the key.
To disable CMEK for the Log Router, set this field to an empty string.

For example: logName="projects/[PROJECT ID]/logs/[LOG ID]" AND severity>=ERROR To match all logs, don't add exclusions and use the following line as the value of filter : logName: Cannot be empty or unset when the value of mode is OVERWRITE . exclusions[] object ( LogExclusion ) Optional.
